name: Chat Quote for WooCommerce
author: prokashsarker2026

sections.description:
Chat Quote for WooCommerce is the ultimate lightweight communication plugin designed to skyrocket your conversion rates. It seamlessly integrates a powerful on-site live chat and a direct-to-WhatsApp messaging system into your WooCommerce store, making it easier than ever for customers to request quotes, ask pre-sale questions, and finalize orders via WhatsApp.

With our plugin, when a customer sends a message from a product page, the product name, price, SKU, and link are automatically attached to their message. You will know exactly what they want to buy the second they message you!

🚀 Why choose Chat Quote for WooCommerce?

  • Order on WhatsApp: Add a beautiful “Order on WhatsApp” or “Get a Quote” button right below your Add to Cart button.
  • Automatic Product Context: When a user clicks the WhatsApp button on a product page, the plugin automatically drafts a message containing the Product Name, Price, SKU, and URL. No more asking “Which product are you talking about?”!
  • Built-in Live Chat Widget: Engage customers with a fast, AJAX-powered floating chat widget.
  • Smart Admin Inbox Dashboard: View and reply to live chat messages right from your WordPress backend. The inbox automatically generates a Beautiful Product Context Card at the top of the chat thread so you instantly see the product image, title, and price the customer is asking about!
  • Customizable Design: Match your brand perfectly. Customize button colors, chat box colors, borders, and even use custom SVG WhatsApp icons.
  • Blazing Fast & Lightweight: Zero bloat. Optimized with AJAX so it won’t slow down your store.

🔥 Key Features Overview:

  • WooCommerce Product Button: Add a dedicated WhatsApp inquiry button on single product pages.
  • Floating WhatsApp Widget: A sleek, mobile-friendly floating chat bubble that stays with the customer across your site.
  • Advanced Admin Chat Dashboard: View conversations, filter unread messages, and reply natively from WordPress.
  • Visual Product Context: The admin dashboard displays rich product cards for product-specific inquiries.
  • Custom Message Templates: Define exactly what the pre-filled WhatsApp message should say using dynamic variables like {product_name} and {product_price}.
  • 100% Mobile Responsive: Designed to look and work perfectly on smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chat-quote-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Navigate to Chat Quote Settings in the left menu of your WordPress admin dashboard to enter your WhatsApp number and configure your design.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes, Chat Quote for WooCommerce requires WooCommerce to be installed and active to function correctly.

Does it automatically send product details to WhatsApp?

Yes! When a user clicks the WhatsApp button on a product page, it automatically appends the product’s name, price, SKU, and link to their drafted WhatsApp message.

Can I customize the colors of the chat widget?

Absolutely. The settings panel allows you to customize the background color, text color, borders, hover states, and even button icons.

How do I view messages sent through the floating chat widget?

Simply go to the Chat Messages tab in your WordPress admin dashboard. You will see a beautiful inbox with all customer inquiries, complete with the product context card!
